steps.title: Create a cs Node class
steps.description: Define a Node class with `data` and `next` properties. Each node holds a value and a reference to the next node in the list. Test by creating a few standalone nodes and linking them manually.
hints: The Node class should have a constructor that takes data and sets next to null
Create 3 nodes and link them: node1.next = node2; node2.next = node3
Print the data of the first node to verify the chain

verification.successMessage: Node class created and linked successfully!
verification.failureMessage: Create a Node class with data and next properties, then link multiple nodes.

steps.title: Implement insert operations
steps.description: Add methods to insert nodes at the beginning (prepend), end (append), and at a specific index in the linked list. Each insertion should update the appropriate next references.
hints: For prepend: create new node, point its next to current head, update head
For append: traverse to the last node, set its next to the new node
Handle edge cases: inserting into an empty list

verification.failureMessage: Implement prepend, append, and insert methods.

steps.title: Implement delete and search
steps.description: Add methods to delete a node by value and search for a value in the list. Deletion should properly reconnect the surrounding nodes.
hints: For delete: find the node before the target, skip the target node
For search: traverse the list and return the node if found
Handle deletion of head node separately

steps.title: Add utility methods
steps.description: Implement printList(), size(), isEmpty(), and toArray() methods. These utilities make the linked list easier to use and debug.
hints: printList should traverse and display each node data
size() should return the count of nodes
toArray() should return an array of all node data values

verification.failureMessage: Implement printList, size, isEmpty, and toArray.

steps.title: Test the complete linked list
steps.description: Create a comprehensive test: insert several values, delete some, search for a value, and display the final list. Verify all operations work end-to-end.
hints: Delete both the head and a middle node
Print the final list to verify correctness

verification.failureMessage: Create a comprehensive test of all linked list operations.
